title: Sughra Nu Nai Dasna
body:
Haye baba Sughra nu ni dasna
Akbar da maut sanerah one seh nahi sakna, sughra nu ni dasna
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ote laake bethi asaan veeran de ghar aaundiya x2
One si veer de sir te aj sehra takna
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Naane de roze te sughra kive baal ke rohndi eh x2
Nai jaandio maa jaye nai watan te walna
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Kenhdi si gal paake bawa chad naa jaavi veer menu x2
Gal saang di sunke baba ujri nahi bachna
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Veer di maut di khabar sune te mar jaavegi behn dukhi x2
Akbar de jigar chu oka barchi nu kadna
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Veer akbar di shaadi da arman barasi sughra nu x2
Vich bande mout da sehra ode sir te sajna
6.Aasa dil vich rehgaya asghar nu gohd kidhaun diya x2
Hurmal de teer ton pehla oda paani mangna
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Sawaan mukhiya retaan te Jawad dukhi de veer diya x2
Akbar di laash nu pyu da bow okha chukna
